title: SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 protocol binding
summary: SOAP dev2 uses the standalone RPC Service Core for operation dispatch and a real native libxml2 envelope parser/writer for SOAP 1.1 and 1.2 faults. A JSON-to-XML codec is not a SOAP implementation. Current scope is conservative document/literal scalar data.
invariants: DTD/XXE, mustUnderstand without approved handlers, encoded style and unsupported nested graphs are rejected.
No live authenticated HTTP/TLS, WSDL/XSD full complex-schema, WS-Security, MTOM or external interop qualification is claimed.
SOAPAction and HTTP metadata must not become unauthorized method selectors.
